highlights: Linked duplicates: sculpt one Part and every copy follows, each in its own place (thanks @ebarranco, #94)
Orbit lock: View > Orbit lock turns the view about X, Y or Z only (thanks foirgairwolf on Discord)
Image to 3D: remove the flat background plane a generated model stands on, in one click (thanks fenix on Discord)
Reconstruct Subdiv: lower levels keep their UVs, even where seams cross coarse faces (thanks @RodTDai, #145)
Timelapse: rendered timelapses no longer flicker between detail levels (thanks @ebarranco)
